entries.text: The **WAT (virtualized)** tab of a Component Model binary no longer goes empty when the component embeds no core modules. Glue-only components (types, imports, exports, instances, aliases) now render their component-level constructs in the same virtualized panel core modules get: foldable per-section headers, search by name or offset, and a clickable offset gutter that jumps to the byte in the hex view. Imports and exports are anchored to their exact byte ranges; sections the parser cannot decode per record (for example canon) show an explicit "not decoded" row instead of failing the view. Rendering works from the in-memory buffer, so it also covers nested components opened from the Components tab, and the plain **Wat** tab now converts in-memory nested views directly from their bytes instead of failing with "No such file or directory".

clusters.summary: Component-level imports, exports, types, aliases, and instances now render as foldable WAT sections with byte-accurate links back to Hex.
clusters.title: Read glue-only components in WAT (virtualized)

entries.text: Nested components of a Component Model binary now open in their own editor view. A **Components** tab lists the embedded component the way **Modules** lists embedded core modules, and clicking the row opens it. Opening is recursive: modules and components inside an already-opened nested view open the same way, and byte offsets accumulate across levels so every nested view is labelled with its absolute offset in the root file. Nested in-memory views don't offer Run actions (there is no file on disk a run configuration could execute) and gain the full tab set of a disk-opened file, including the plain Wat tab and, for core modules, DWARF panels.

clusters.summary: Open embedded components and modules recursively from the Components and Modules tabs, with every nested view retaining its location in the original binary.
clusters.title: Open nested components as editor views
